note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (BJP-led NDA coalition under Vajpayee), not measured data. Influence reflects a civilian-controlled military, large trade-union federations tied to several parties, a very large rural electorate, caste and religious minorities organised through regional parties, and a large, plural press.
